newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia denies report of possible coup.
newsitem.headline: Russia denies report of possible coup.

text.p: The Russian Defence Ministry said on Monday there was no truth in reports circulating in financial markets of a possible coup plot.
"I have no information about this...there's no coup," said the duty officer at the Ministry's press office.
The reports appeared to stem from an article in the German newspaper Welt am Sonntag at the weekend.

The weekly carried a front-page report, sourced to Nikolai Nor-Mesek at the Institute for Soviet Studies in Frankfurt, saying soldiers and labour unions had "united" in five army garrisons to prepare opposition to the Russian government and were "discussing" marching on Moscow to occupy the State Duma and Federal Council.
